thread:
ana: ok team — new idea: a 'Dev Garden' cohort sprint + OSS demo day to push a set of small tutorials and a lightweight reference app. goal: create content that feeds into a launch post, a short benchmark narrative, and a 45-min webinar. thoughts? :seedling:

sam: love it. do we want a single repo with tagged 'lessons' or multiple tiny repos? my vote: single mono-repo with clear folders + one demo app. easier for outreach and PRs.

jordan: mono-repo + starter issues for community contributions. we can have 3 tutorial tracks: quickstart (hosted API), cost/perf (benchmarks + quantization tips), and infra (private + dedicated howto). each track -> 2 short posts + 1 webinar panel slot.

li: i'll draft a visual identity for the repo readme and social cards. can we standardize hero image sizes so marketing ops can schedule assets quickly? :camera_flash: 

ana: yes — standard sizes, and please make a small set of shareable GIFs showing the app in <30s. we want quick snackable vids for X and LinkedIn.

sam: timeline proposal: week 0 — scaffold repo + baseline tutorial; week 1 — community sprint (contribs); week 2 — finalize tutorial posts + benchmark runs; week 3 — webinar + launch post. aggressive but doable if we scope each tutorial to ~800 words and a sample app.

jordan: agree. for benchmarks we should include a reproducible script and a short YAML of config. sample snippet for bench runner:```bash
python bench.py --model redwood-small --seq 512 --batch 8 --profile=latency
```

li: for the social copy I'll need TL;DR bullets: what it is, why it matters (latency/cost improvements), call-to-action (star repo + register for webinar).

ana: registration — keep it internal-first. landing page + email capture (we own the leads). sam, can ops wire an Eventbrite + redirect that tags UTM params?

sam: yep. use this pattern for utm: `?utm_source=devgarden&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=devgarden_launch`. we'll also pass a hidden param `cohort=community-sprint` so we can route leads.

jordan: lead routing: map cohort param -> funnel tag in CRM. if cohort=community-sprint then assign to 'community-engagement' queue; if cohort=partner-demo then 'sales-sdr'. can we get a strawman mapping before week 2?

ana: i'll ping growth to confirm. also need speaker leads for webinar: me (host), jordan (bench talk), and 1 external community maintainer. li can demo the UI/visuals.

li: happy to demo. quick note — let's pre-record the demo clip in case of live issues.

launch-bot: Reminder: create a launch checklist in #marketing-launches and set due dates.

sam: copy checklist items: repo scaffold, tutorial #1 draft, tutorial #2 draft, benchmark script + baseline results, social assets, webinar page, email drips, PR draft, partner outreach list.

jordan: measurement plan: publish benchmark table with median latency, p50/p95, and cost per 1k tokens. include a simple chart and a link to raw results. we should also add a short 'how we measured' section to avoid confusion.

ana: messaging iteration: initial draft will be developer-centric — "ship reliable LLM features with predictable costs" then we can tweak for enterprise compliance angle in the Dedicated/Private followups.

li: for the OSS launch post tone — friendly, practical, and example-driven. include a small FAQ for common infra questions: VPC, keys, and model licensing.

sam: outreach plan: partner with two community newsletters, post on X, LinkedIn, and community forums. also push to repo stars program and seed contributors.

jordan: action items for today: (1) sam -> create repo scaffold + starter issues, (2) li -> first visual mockups, (3) ana -> webinar landing page draft, (4) me -> bench runner template. deliver by EOD Fri.

ana: thanks all — i'll round these up into a tiny brief and drop in #marketing-launches. excited to test a cohort flow. :rocket:
